## Task 1 · The first launch of Moon Racer

A friend makes the racing game *Moon Racer*. They have **one Windows
laptop** and **two Android phones**; their players are in Jordan.

a) For which platform can your friend make a build this week: Android or
iOS?

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

b) Why must the game be tested on more than one Android phone? Write **A**,
**B** or **C**. (A) Android phones differ in screen, chip and version
(B) Google Play asks for two phones (C) one phone is not enough for the
store photos

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

c) A bug appears only on **Android 11**. Must your friend still fix it
(yes / no)?

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

## Task 2 · The share in your country

Find the share of Android phones and of iPhones in your country in a dated
report. You may ask an AI where to look, but take the numbers from the
report itself. Write the two shares (%), the name of the source and its
month.
